models.P1_GLOBAL: global standardized process features and registered spatial-group slopes only
models.P1_TREE: P1 plus terminal-tree Gaussian random intercept
models.P2_HIER: P1_TREE plus gauged-station Gaussian random intercept
models.P2_OBS_ONLY: same implemented 3383-column space, observation likelihood plus Gaussian priors, no contrast pseudo-response
models.P2_STRONG_SHRINK: P2_OBS_ONLY with station and slope prior SD halved
models.STATION_ID_ONLY: intercept plus station Gaussian random intercept
models.PERMUTED_STATE_NULL: P2_HIER capacity with dynamic process columns permuted within station and calendar month across years

negative_control_gate: selected candidate must significantly beat both STATION_ID_ONLY and PERMUTED_STATE_NULL in paired station bootstrap
mainline_policy: temporal OOF is primary; station-blind P1 and later LOSO/LOTO are transfer diagnostics
